description: Read by scripts/test-env (the one entry point) and scripts/test-env.mjs at run time. The entry point starts the helper under env -i: HOME and PATH are set from `boundary`, and only the names in `inherit` pass through from the caller. The command `run` starts gets the same, then the env file and the pins. `run` holds the program to the plain-argv rule by what it really is: a shell (by a name in `run.shells`, a file in the system's `run.shellsFile`, the same file or a copy), a wrapper (`run.wrappers`) or a file the kernel runs with `run.fallbackShell`. docs/LOCAL_TESTING.md justifies every name and path here. Database inputs, loader inputs (DOTENV_*, NODE_OPTIONS, npm_config_*, JITI_*, TSX_*, BASH_ENV, ENV), NODE_ENV, HOME and PATH are refused in `inherit`.
